dishes.name: Languedoc-style snails
dishes.desc: Small petit-gris snails cooked slowly in a sauce of ham, walnuts, chard, garlic and parsley. A staple starter on Carcassonne menus, less known than the parsley-butter version.

dishes.name: Duck gizzard salad
dishes.desc: Duck gizzards, confit or pan-seared, served on a salad with crusty bread. Duck is everywhere in Cathar country, and this is the usual way to start a meal in the old town.

dishes.name: Le Carcassonnais
dishes.desc: A puff-pastry brioche filled with vanilla cream and candied fruit, a Sunday treat from the city's bakeries.

dishes.name: Iced cassoulet
dishes.desc: A Carcassonne dessert shaped like a small cassoulet or burger, layering nougatine, vanilla, chestnut and morello cherry. Sold at several pastry shops in the city.

dishes.name: Écus de la Cité
dishes.desc: Small round chocolate coins stamped with the emblem of the fortified city, in dark or milk chocolate. A local sweet sold in confectioners and pastry shops.
